items: Ace Typing: tap the keyboard at the top, or say "teach me to type", for typing lessons from the home row up to whole sentences.
Letters turn green or red as you type, the next key glows on the big keyboard, and a speedometer shows your words a minute live.
Finish a lesson for stars, confetti and your best speed. The keyboard turns into a heat map of the keys you missed most.
Say "practice the home row" to jump straight in, or "how fast can I type" for a speed test.
Ace is bouncier: buttons squish when you press them and boing back, and the header icons jump when you tap them.
Chat bubbles pop in, yours from the right and Ace's from the left, and the orb hops when Ace replies.
Settings springs open one section at a time, with springy switches and an orb at the top that smiles when you tap it.
Turn it off in Settings > Look and feel > Bouncy animations. Reduce Motion in the iPad's Settings keeps everything still.
Call Ace: tap the phone button, or say "call Ace", for a full-screen voice call.
The orb reacts while Ace listens, thinks and talks, with live captions of both of you.
Talk over Ace to interrupt, plus Mute, Speaker and a call timer. Say "hang up" or "bye" to end.
Small talk gets a reply that fits: "yo what up" gets a what's-up line, "how are you" gets how Ace is doing, and compliments and "sorry" get their own replies.
Works in Normal and Sassy mode, at every stop of the Sass slider.
Say "turn on sassy mode" or "turn off sassy mode" to switch, and it never asks about Apple Home.
Understands more questions said in your own words, like "what's a baby frog known as" or "how many years can a dog live".
Fixes more short typos, like "eet" for "eat".
A much bigger brain: Ace now knows about 60,000 answers, about 20 times more than before.
About 4,000 trivia questions to play.
About 1,000 recipes to cook from.
About 1,100 ready-made scripts and code examples.
Better at questions it has never seen before, and just as right on the old ones.
Sass slider: in Settings, under Personality, pick Mild, Spicy or Extra when Sassy mode is on. Extra is the full attitude.
Mild is a light quip now and then, Spicy is a sassy line on most replies, and Extra is every reply with big eye-rolls.
The eye-rolls and the sassy voice get bigger the higher the slider goes.
Chatting like "roast me", "lol" or "whatever" gets a real reply instead of a web search.
"Search it" searches what you asked before, or asks "Search what?".
Goodbyes like "I'm gonna leave" or "gtg" get a goodbye, and the orb goes to sleep.
Sassy mode: switch it on in Settings, under Personality, and Ace answers with a LOT of attitude. Still the right answers.
Sassy Ace has its own set of about 2,000 sassy answers and lines: small talk, jokes, capitals, space, animals, science, math and words.
Ask the same thing twice in Sassy mode and Ace gets extra sassy about it.
The orb rolls its eyes and gives side-eye in Sassy mode.
Sassy voice: Ace says its sassy lines out loud with extra drama, sighs included.
This What's new card. It shows once after each update, and you can open it again in Settings.
Right answers for world leaders and capitals, like who leads the UK.
A full chocolate cake recipe, with a quick mug cake offered as a choice.
Ace lives in the Dynamic Island, with new thinking animations.
Ace says hello when you open the app.
Ace remembers your favorite things and brings them up now and then.
Mood sounds, and seasonal outfits for the orb.
